question: Does concentration of causally observed net token acquisition among early Pump wallets add signal-quality information beyond Participant Quality and existing flow evidence?

feature_contract.definition: For decoded Pump trades of the episode mint causally observed from T0 through T0+5s inclusive, aggregate token_amount_raw per wallet as +buy and -sell; retain only positive ending observed net balances; divide each positive wallet balance by the sum of positive observed net balances; primary feature is the sum of squared shares.
feature_contract.interpretation: Concentration of observed early net-acquired token inventory across wallets; this is not full on-chain holder concentration and does not claim true wallet inventory outside the observed launch window.
feature_contract.normalization: sum of positive observed net token balances within the same T0..T0+5s causal window
feature_contract.event_causality: first_received_wall_ns must be within episode T0..T0+5s and decoded chain timestamp must be within observed_t0..observed_t0+5

outcomes.primary: ROUTE_CLOSED gross Fixed+60 standardized outcome from the already-captured frozen route contract

directional_read.next_step_if_sufficient: mechanism/robustness review, then freeze an independent prospective confirmation using the exact feature
directional_read.next_step_if_insufficient_or_not_increme: close this feature family without threshold retuning or sample extension based on observed outcomes
